description: In every PA model, for a fixed Boolean program \(q\), if some \(i\le n\) satisfies \(q(\vec x,i)=1\), the specified bounded-witness program returns an index at most \(n\) whose test value is one.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.boundedWitness_spec.{u}
  {M : Type u} [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {r : ℕ} (q : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program (r + 1))
  (x : Fin r → M)
  (hq :
    ∀ (i : M),
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BooleanValue (q.value (Fin.snoc x i)))
  (n : M)
  (hex :
    ∃ i,
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M i n ∧
        q.value (Fin.snoc x i) = Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1) :
  q.value
        (Fin.snoc x
          ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.boundedWitness
                q).value
            (Fin.snoc x n))) =
      Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1 ∧
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
      ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.boundedWitness q).value
        (Fin.snoc x n))
      n
